_comment: STUBBED policy administration system. In production the gate reads these fields over an API from the carrier's policy and claims systems. ASSUMPTION: real-time programmatic access exists. If a carrier's policy system is batch-only, the gate cannot run synchronously and the whole flow becomes asynchronous — a deployment discovery, not a design change.

CLM-1001._scenario: Clean path, real photographs. Front corner damage on a panel carrying no sensors. Expect: verify tier.
CLM-1001.loss_description: Scraped a concrete pillar while turning into a parking garage at low speed. The front bumper on the driver's side corner is creased and pulled away below the headlight.

CLM-1002._scenario: Insufficient evidence. Attempt 1: a specific re-request naming three views. Attempt 2 waits for the resubmission: upload the three Navigator photos from the samples folder and it proceeds to an estimate; upload fewer, or poor ones, and it escalates to a claims agent at the attempt cap.
CLM-1002.loss_description: Scraped the rear wheel on the driver's side against a curb while parallel parking. The rim is gouged along its outer edge.

CLM-1003._scenario: The surprise. A rear bumper scuff on a sedan with parking sensors. It looks trivially automatable, and it is not. Expect: the ADAS penalty drops it to starting point.
CLM-1003.loss_description: Backed into a low post in a parking lot. The rear bumper is scuffed and gouged across the middle.

CLM-1004._scenario: Authenticity flag. Photo capture time predates the reported loss. Expect: flagged, confidence reduced, routed for review. NOT denied.
CLM-1004.loss_description: Sideswiped by a delivery van while parked on the street. There is a crease along the front fender on the passenger side.

CLM-1005._scenario: Tier 1 exclusion: injury reported. Expect: not processed.
CLM-1005.loss_description: Rear-ended at a stop light. The driver reports neck pain.

CLM-1006._scenario: Tier 1 exclusion: policy not in force at loss date. Expect: not processed, no compute spent.
CLM-1006.loss_description: A shopping cart rolled into the driver's door in a store parking lot.

CLM-1007._scenario: Low confidence, honestly reached. Side-swipe down the left side into the rear bumper corner. Photographs are adequate; the damage is not. Structural lines the model cannot judge from outside, one line the costing stage cannot price, sparse comparables, and a blind spot radar in the damaged corner. Expect: low confidence tier.
CLM-1007.loss_description: Sideswiped by a car changing lanes on the highway. Scrapes and dents run along the driver's side from the rear door to the back bumper.

CLM-1008._scenario: Manipulated photos. One photo's metadata names editing software. The other declares it was generated by AI, using the label AI generators write. Expect: flagged, confidence reduced, kept out of verify and routed to a person. NOT denied.
CLM-1008.loss_description: A hit-and-run in a grocery store parking lot. The driver's door has a dent below the handle.
